worldcombat.skill.populationbomb.summary: Fellows gather in droves, then pounce at the target one after another from all sides: each one settles a small hit and rolls its own accuracy, and the first one to miss ends the streak. It hits 1 to 10 times, length uncertain.
worldcombat.skill.populationbomb.use.0: Call a band of fellows for a running combo
worldcombat.skill.populationbomb.use.1: Finish a wounded target with a streak of uncertain length
worldcombat.skill.populationbomb.use.2: Stack a run of small hits before the target can answer
worldcombat.skill.populationbomb.descrip: Against an aimed foe or empty point, up to %2$s fellows leave the queue %4$s apart, each dealing about %1$s Normal contact and slicing damage; each rolls its own %3$s accuracy and only settles on a real collision, and the first miss ends the streak, as does the target falling or leaving. The target's Defence, type match-up and crits are settled per hit.

Fellows queue at a %4$s block ring around the user, %5$s blocks above its feet, then rush at %1$s blocks per tick toward the aim point from as far as %2$s blocks; each has a collision radius of about %3$s blocks, settles only on hitting a non-friendly body, and whiffs on a wall or at the end of its range.
The muster takes %1$s; higher levels call more fellows.
worldcombat.skill.populationbomb.swarm.o: Mouse Sea: combo cap x1.7 (up to ten) and a tighter gap, but each hit is 15% lighter with 5% lower accuracy and +4 ticks of cooldown: long and unstable.
Elite Squad: combo cap x1, each hit 30% heavier with 5% better accuracy and -2 ticks of cooldown, but a slower gap: short and reliable.
worldcombat.skill.populationbomb.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
From level %1$s each hit rises to %2$s and the combo cap to %3$s.
From level %1$s each hit rises to %2$s, the combo cap to %3$s and the launch range to %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.populationbomb.prefere: On: combo cap x1.7 (up to ten), gap -1 tick, cooldown +4 ticks, but each hit x0.85 and accuracy -5%%. Off (Elite Squad): each hit x1.3, accuracy +5%%, gap +1.5 ticks, cooldown -2 ticks.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of calling the band. Larger values open from further out.
On: wounded targets rank higher, to finish them with the streak; off: every target scores the same.
world_combat.move.populationbomb.text.mi: Fellow %1$s misses and the band scatters
